about: Probe of the Climate Hazards Center's own pages on CHIRTS-ERA5 and its Heat Monitor, prompted by a CHC blog post (9 November 2026) the owner pasted without its address. The pages are staged to read what they say before a Heat Tool Finder record is drafted; the record cites only terms found here. The blog's finding that ERA5 reads cooler than CHIRTS-Daily in warm extremes is held until the owner supplies its URL (see ledger.md).
